title: Parkio Daily: EPCOT Holidays Kick Off, Avengers Campus Adds Heroes
teaser: EPCOT's Festival of the Holidays opened Friday and runs through Dec. 30, while Bucky and Yelena join Avengers Campus.

bignews.title: EPCOT Festival of the Holidays runs through December 30
bignews.body: Disney Food Blog says the 2026 EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays began November 27 and runs through December 30. It includes holiday kitchens, the Candlelight Processional and seasonal merchandise. WDWNT reports Santa Goofy meets daily in the Odyssey pavilion from 11:30 a.m. to 3:15 p.m. and 4:10 p.m. to 6:45 p.m.

parkioInsight.text: Opening weekend crowds often peak around the Candlelight Processional and popular booths. Hitting the holiday kitchens in the first hour of the day usually means shorter lines.

bignews.title: Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova join Avengers Campus
bignews.body: Disney Parks Blog says Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova start Heroic Encounters at Disney California Adventure on November 27, for a limited time. It is their first time in Avengers Campus. The blog says the Fantastic Four began meets there on November 20.

parkioInsight.text: New meet-and-greets tend to draw longer queues, especially midday. Heading to Avengers Campus early may help you catch them before lines build.

topstories.title: Blizzard Beach closure extended through Sunday
topstories.body: Inside the Magic reports Disney's Blizzard Beach is now listed as closed all day Sunday, November 29, after an earlier plan to reopen. WDWNT also noted a closure through the weekend amid cold, rainy weather. The site says Typhoon Lagoon is also unavailable.

parkioInsight.text: Water park plans this weekend are likely to fall through. Check Disney's official operating calendar before you go, and consider a theme park day instead.

topstories.title: Jollywood Nights down to four dates
topstories.body: Inside the Magic reports the December 21 Disney Jollywood Nights sold out as of Friday, November 27. Four dates remain: December 14, December 23, January 3 and January 5. Tickets for those run $189 to $199 for adults and $179 to $189 for ages three to nine, per the site.

parkioInsight.text: Remaining dates may go quickly. If you want in, booking soon is likely safer than waiting.

topstories.title: Avengers: Doomsday treats planned for Disneyland Resort
topstories.body: Disney Parks Blog lists new Avengers: Doomsday food at Disneyland Resort, including the Doom Dog and Spiced Doom Cookie. They are listed as available December 10, 2026, through February 18, 2027. The film opens in theaters December 18.

parkioInsight.text: These are not available yet, so mark December 10 on your calendar. Items like these often draw lines in the first few days.

topstories.title: Hexed character Billie Doe debuts at the parks
topstories.body: Disney Parks Blog says Billie Doe from Hexed is making her Disney Parks debut. At Walt Disney World she appears in Animation Courtyard at Hollywood Studios. At Disneyland, Disney says she may make select appearances outside Fantasyland near the Frontierland path.

parkioInsight.text: Appearances are described as select, so check the My Disney Experience or Disneyland app for times. Going early often helps with new character meets.

icymi.title: Hallmark's Disney World movie premieres November 28
icymi.body: Disney Parks Blog says Hallmark's Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True premieres November 28, 2026, on Hallmark Channel. It streams November 29 on Disney+ and Hulu.

icymi.title: Disneyland security area walls come down further
icymi.body: WDWNT reports more construction walls have come down around the new security area at Disneyland Resort. Guests can now walk under almost all of the new awning. The work is tied to a planned pedestrian bridge to a new parking structure.

spotlight.title: EPCOT Holiday Cookie Stroll
spotlight.body: Disney Food Blog says the Cookie Stroll is back. Collect stamps on five cookies from participating booths in your festival passport, then pick up a prize at Holiday Sweets & Treats. This year's prize is a Bean Bunny potholder plus candy.

parkioInsight.text: Split the five cookies across a group to keep it manageable. Start early in the day, since cookie booths may get busier by afternoon.
